subject: Operator security checklist: SSO/SCIM/RBAC evidence for Northpoint
messages:
From: Elaine Park <elaine.park@northpoint.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-03-21T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Operator checklist request (SSO/SCIM/RBAC)

Hi Jordan,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. As part of our procurement security review I need a short operator/operator-team facing checklist and evidence pack that explains how Redwood handles:
- SAML/OIDC SSO: IdP integration, attribute mapping, session handling
- SCIM: provisioning flows, deprovisioning time windows, error handling
- RBAC & admin controls: built-in admin roles, delegated admin, audit trails

Our security team will review a one-page checklist and a few sample artifacts (config screenshots, SCIM schema sample, and an admin audit log snippet). Could you attach the checklist and an evidence pdf we can share with our internal auditors?

Target timeline: internal review by Friday 2028-03-24.

Please loop in whoever owns the admin controls docs.

Thanks,
Elaine Park
Security Operations Manager
Northpoint Systems

--

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elaine Park <elaine.park@northpoint.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-03-21T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Operator checklist request (SSO/SCIM/RBAC)

Hi Elaine — attaching an operator checklist and a concise evidence pack for your auditors. Highlights below:

• SSO: We support SAML 2.0 and OIDC; we provide reference IdP metadata, automatic attribute mapping templates, and session expiry controls per tenant. We include a recommended attribute map and IdP test plan in the pack.

• SCIM: Full SCIM 2.0 support for user and group provisioning. Typical deprovisioning policy is configurable; default is immediate deprovision + 30-day soft-delete for account recovery. SCIM error codes and retry semantics are documented.

• RBAC & Admin Controls: Built-in roles (Owner/Admin/Operator/Read-only). Delegated admin is supported via scoped roles and team boundaries. All admin actions are logged and exported to customer audit logs; we include a redacted audit snippet.

Attachments included:
- redwood-operator-checklist-v1.xlsx (operator checklist, one page)
- sso-scim-rbac-evidence-pack.pdf (screenshots, SCIM schema, audit snippet)

If your team needs a deeper SCIM schema mapping workshop, Ben can run a 60-minute technical session this week.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com
Mobile: +1 415-555-0198

--

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-03-22T09:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Operator checklist request (SSO/SCIM/RBAC)

Jordan / Kim — quick clarifications before we finalize the pack:

1) SCIM soft-delete window: the evidence pack currently states 30 days by default. For Dedicated/private customers we can shorten or extend that via tenant policy; confirm whether Northpoint is OK with default or they want a custom SLA noted in docs.

2) Audit export formats: PDF snippet is fine for procurement, but Operations often asks for a CDC (JSON lines) sample; do we attach a redacted JSONL sample in addition?

3) SSO session policy: include the tenant-level session idle timeout and absolute session timeout fields and sample metadata. I can add the screenshots of the console where those are configured.

If Jordan confirms, I’ll produce a v1.1 of the pack with JSONL audit export sample and console screenshots.

- Ben
Principal Product Manager, Access Controls
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
